notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting attached to a creature without summoning sickness.
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with enough mana to cast it.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {R}.
description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Deekah triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the spell's mana value.
The Fractal enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying the instant or sorcery spell you cast.
Repeat from step 2.
